budget.definition: exact-Float64 UTF8 serialized retained clock including preimages/query audit, recipes, nativeCut/layout, schedule, metric map entries+keys, group entries+keys/size ledger, scalar key sets, counters and compile-local prepared recipe layouts/keys/native subtitle fit/held family entry-key representation/held records+size ledger/local templates+references+intern keys/current clone and live payload plus static frame-data/layout references/clock-own index and largest current scalar. Per-scalar recipe/glyph detail arrays exist only for onScalar diagnostics; ordinary compilation counts current geometry/layout/metric/matrix temporaries but does not retain prior recipe detail; conservative full model serialization is additionally counted during output construction; FD work static graph is privately frozen and exact-value bytes reused; dynamic clockRows/current are recounted every callback, plus fixed cache reference/number/container management upper bound. Not JS heap/RSS. Entry sums include their full standalone JSON encoding. A fixed serialized wrapper plus one separator byte per retained entry conservatively covers outer containers/property names/delimiters. During output construction the full serialized output is added again. Caller inputs, rendering env/context/function handles and serialization encoder implementation allocation are not heap-accounted.
